Tooltip.standardTooltip: Select the applicable cleanroom standard (e.g., ISO, FDA, GMP) for your facility.
Tooltip.classificationTooltip: Choose the specific cleanroom class based on your application's particle control requirements.
Tooltip.acphTooltip: Defines how many times the entire room air volume is replaced each hour.
Tooltip.heatingSystemTypeTooltip: Select the category that best describes the environment where this air-heating system will be used.
Tooltip.coolingSystemTypeTooltip: Select the environment type where this cooling system will be installed.
Tooltip.heatingMethodTooltip: Select the heat transfer medium (Hot Water or Steam) used by your heating coils.
Tooltip.coolingMethodTooltip: Choose the cooling medium (e.g., Chilled Water or Brine or DX) used to lower the air temperature.
Tooltip.systemTooltip: Select the system you are looking for
Tooltip.ventilationSystemTypeTooltip: Select the environment type to determine airflow standards.
Tooltip.requiredTemperatureTooltip: Set the target indoor air temperature required to maintain environmental stability or occupant comfort.
Tooltip.requiredHumidityTooltip: Specify the desired relative humidity percentage to prevent static, condensation, or material degradation.
Tooltip.roomNameTooltip: Enter a unique, descriptive name for this room or zone. This name will appear in all reports, calculations, and zone listings.
Tooltip.roomDimensionsTooltip: Tip: Measure from interior wall to interior wall for accurate calculations.
Tooltip.lengthTooltip: The length of the room in meters.
Tooltip.widthTooltip: The width of the room in meters.
Tooltip.occupancyTooltip: The maximum number of people expected to occupy this room simultaneously during normal operations.
Tooltip.equipmentLoadTooltip: Total electrical load from all equipment in the room, measured in kilowatts (kW)
Tooltip.lightingLoadTooltip: Lighting power density in Watts per square meter.
Tooltip.infiltrationsTooltip: The estimated number of times the total volume of air in the room is replaced by uncontrolled air leaking in from outside or adjacent spaces.
Tooltip.freshAirTooltip: The percentage of the total supply airflow that is drawn from the outside to ensure adequate oxygen levels and indoor air quality.
Tooltip.exhaustAirTooltip: Entered in %. The volume of air intentionally removed from the space per second to maintain pressure balance or remove contaminants.
Tooltip.exhaustAirCfmTooltip: Entered in CFM.The volume of air intentionally removed from the space per second to maintain pressure balance or remove contaminants.
Tooltip.acphValueTooltip: The total number of times the entire volume of air in the room is replaced by filtered supply air every hour.
Tooltip.plantRoomDistanceTooltip: Specify the distance of the plant room from the AHU in meters. This influences the ducting and pump design.
Tooltip.panelThicknessTooltip: Select the thickness of the AHU panel and the profile type.
Tooltip.panelConstructionTooltip: Specify the material and coating for the inner and outer skins of the AHU panels.
Tooltip.airHandlingTooltip: Select the construction material and type of Volume Control Dampers (VCD).
Tooltip.fireControlTooltip: Select the location and type of fire control dampers for the AHU.
Tooltip.vfdTooltip: Indicate if a Variable Frequency Drive is required for fan speed control.
Tooltip.pressureGaugeTooltip: Select the differential pressure gauge range and location for filter monitoring.
Tooltip.virusBurnerTooltip: Choose the type of ultraviolet germicidal irradiation (UVGI) or UVC for virus control.
Tooltip.doorInterlockingTooltip: Specify if door interlocking is required for the AHU sections.
Tooltip.bmsMonitoringTooltip: Indicate if the AHU parameters need to be monitored by the Building Management System.
Tooltip.emsMonitoringTooltip: Indicate if the AHU parameters need to be monitored by the Environmental Monitoring System.
Tooltip.humidistatTooltip: Select if a humidistat is required for humidity control.
Tooltip.thermostatTooltip: Select if a thermostat is required for temperature control.
Tooltip.flowControlValveTooltip: Choose the type of water flow control valve (2-Way or 3-Way).
Tooltip.yStrainerTooltip: Indicate if a Y-Strainer is required in the piping.
Tooltip.purgeWallTooltip: Specify if a purge wall is required for the system.
Tooltip.pipeConfigurationTooltip: Select the entry point for the water piping into the AHU.
Tooltip.treatedFreshAirTooltip: Choose if the Fresh Air unit is combined with the main AHU or standalone.
Tooltip.preFilterTooltip: Select the efficiency grade for the pre-filter (e.g., G3, G4).
Tooltip.fineFilterTooltip: Select the efficiency grade for the fine filter (e.g., F7, F9).
Tooltip.hepaFilterTooltip: Select the efficiency grade for the HEPA filter (e.g., H13, H14).
Tooltip.carbonFilterTooltip: Specify if an activated carbon filter is required for odor control.
Tooltip.staticPressureTooltip: Formula: (Plant Room Distance * 0.7) + (Final ∆p of selected filters in mmWG) + (Additional ∆p in mmWG)
